title: Hardcoded signing key in TokenService allows arbitrary token forgery
detail: src/aurora/aurora-identity/src/main/java/cloud/aurora/identity/TokenService.java:L18 declares SIGNING_KEY as a static final String literal; this key is used at L23 to compute token signatures, so anyone with read access to the source or compiled class can forge any token issued by this service.

title: MD5 used to sign authentication tokens — tokens are forgeable
detail: src/aurora/aurora-identity/src/main/java/cloud/aurora/identity/TokenService.java:L22 uses MessageDigest.getInstance('MD5') to compute the token signature applied at L23-25; MD5 is collision-prone and cannot serve as a MAC, allowing an attacker to forge valid-looking tokens. Upgraded to high because MD5 directly undermines token integrity for authentication.
